content: 📣 NOW HIRING: PMU INSTRUCTOR | $40–$45/HR The Ohio Institute of Permanent Makeup is seeking an experienced PMU artist ready to step into education, mentor students, and help shape the next generation of artists. We handle the rest. The School Director manages ongoing student oversight, online coursework and grading, apprenticeship requirements, remediation, and final program completion decisions. This allows you to focus on teaching, demonstrating, mentoring, and developing strong PMU artists. We’re looking for: ✔️ 3+ years of professional PMU experience ✔️ Strong portfolio, including healed work ✔️ Clear communication and presentation skills ✔️ Confidence demonstrating techniques in front of students ✔️ Professionalism, patience, and high standards ✔️ Teaching or mentoring experience preferred, but not required ✔️ Ability to meet The Ohio State Board of Career Colleges & Schools instructor requirements 💰 $40–$45/hour 📅 Flexible, pre-scheduled cohort sessions 🎓 Small class sizes (max 3) 📍 Northfield OH 📩 Send your resume + PMU portfolio to bebrowedetc@gmail.com #PMUInstructor #PMUEducator #PermanentMakeupArtist #PMUEducation #ohiopmu

author: Stephen Steele Jackson
title: Hi everyone! I am looking for a new illustrator for the second book in my LGBTQ+ children…
content: Hi everyone! I am looking for a new illustrator for the second book in my LGBTQ+ children’s book series featuring Miss Lexi, a drag queen character based on the one I perform as in real life. I understand that this subject matter may not be the right fit for every illustrator, and that is completely okay. If it is not a good fit for you, please simply scroll past. I would like to keep the conversation respectful and welcoming, so hateful, discriminatory, or disrespectful comments are not welcome. I had hoped to work with Lily Quintana again, who illustrated the first book, but her Instagram account appears to have been deleted, and I have not been able to reach her by email. I am not sure what has happened. If Lily is still illustrating and anyone knows a current professional way to contact her, please let me know. Otherwise, I am officially looking for a new illustrator! The illustrations for book two must match the style and overall feel of the first book as closely as possible. The only returning characters are Miss Lexi Andrews and Max, so their appearances will need to remain recognizable and consistent with book one. The rest of the characters will be new to this story. I have included reference images below so interested illustrators can see the specific style I am looking for and decide whether the project would be a good fit. This is a paid project. I am only accepting original, human-created artwork. No AI-generated or AI-assisted illustrations will be considered. To be considered, please comment below with: • A direct link to your online portfolio • Examples of previous children’s books or other completed illustration projects • Links to published work, client credits, or another way for me to verify that the artwork is your original work To help me keep submissions organized and avoid spam, please do not comment only with “DM me” or send an unsolicited private message. I will reach out directly to the illustrators whose portfolios and experience appear to be the best match for the project. Thank you! I am excited to find an illustrator who can help continue the characters and visual world established in the first book. Please take a look at the reference images below to see whether your style might be a good fit!
